DDW has not independently confirmed that WorkL.com suffered a breach or authenticated the provenance of the dataset. Notably, the visible sample contains timestamps from 2022–2023, so the claimed August 2026 compromise date should not be interpreted as evidence that all records are recent.  #DDW #DarkWeb #WorkL #DataBreach #DataLeak #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence

🇫🇷 French Flight Reservation Platform Reserver.fr Data Allegedly Leaked  A threat actor claims to have released a database obtained from Reserver.fr, described as a French flight reservation platform.  According to the forum post:  * 19,495 database entries are allegedly exposed * Records reportedly span 2016–2024 * The actor claims an API misconfiguration allowed data extraction without authentication * The alleged exposure includes names, phone numbers and email addresses * Flight reservation data reportedly includes departure/arrival cities, travel dates, passenger counts, cabin/class and baggage information * Additional datasets reportedly contain customer contact messages, callback phone numbers and animal-transport information * The actor claims the vulnerability was subsequently patched * The datasets were published for free on August 19, 2026  ⚠️ The combination of identity, contact and historical travel information could increase phishing, impersonation and social-engineering risks for affected individuals.  🔎 Analyst Note: This is currently a threat-actor claim. DDW has not independently verified the reported API vulnerability, the provenance of the approximately 19.5K records, or whether the exposed information originated directly from Reserver.fr.  #DDW #DarkWeb #France #DataBreach #DataLeak #Travel #CyberSecurity #ThreatIntelligence

🇧🇴 Bolivia's National Identification Service SEGIP Allegedly Breached  A threat actor using the alias "kr1pt0n" claims to have exfiltrated data from Bolivia's Servicio General de Identificación Personal (SEGIP), the government agency responsible for personal identification services.  According to the forum post:  * Approximately 4 GB of allegedly confidential documents were exfiltrated * The material reportedly includes agreements with public and private institutions * Cooperation agreements and institutional documentation are allegedly included * Internal and user manuals are reportedly part of the leak * The actor published screenshots of numerous documents as purported evidence * Visible samples appear to reference agreements involving SEGIP and other Bolivian institutions  ⚠️ Unlike a conventional PII database leak, the material shown appears primarily institutional and operational. If authentic, internal agreements and documentation could reveal relationships, processes and potentially sensitive administrative information.  🔎 Analyst Note: The screenshots provide some supporting evidence that the actor possesses documents referencing SEGIP, but they do not independently establish how the files were obtained or confirm the claimed 4 GB compromise. DDW has not independently verified the intrusion or full dataset.  #DDW #DarkWeb #Bolivia #SEGIP #DataBreach #Government #ThreatIntelligence

🕵️ New OSINT Tool: TrackWanted Puts Wanted Persons, Private Jets & Military Aircraft on One Map  A new open-source intelligence platform called TrackWanted has appeared, combining multiple public-data sources into a single interactive 3D globe.  * The platform currently indexes 35 public wanted cases  * It includes wanted notices sourced from publicly available police and government agency information  * Wanted-person entries include estimated geographic areas, uncertainty visualization and confidence scores  * The platform also tracks 81 private aircraft associated with billionaires, prominent individuals and heads of state  * Aircraft registrations are cross-referenced against aviation registry sources  * A separate military board currently covers 32 military and government airframes, including transport, tanker, surveillance and command aircraft  * Users can also search aircraft registrations and examine estimated flight-related carbon emissions  * The service is free and does not require registration  ⚠️ Important: TrackWanted states that wanted-person locations are estimates derived from public reporting and should NOT be interpreted as real-time locations.  Aircraft positions are also described by the platform as simulated telemetry based on realistic schedules rather than confirmed live positions.  ⚠️ Analyst Note: The interesting part isn't any individual dataset — most of the underlying information is already public. The value is aggregation. Bringing wanted notices, aviation registries, military aircraft information and geographic intelligence into a single interface can significantly reduce the time required for preliminary OSINT research. Analysts should still validate every result against the original authoritative source before drawing conclusions.  Source: track-wanted.live #DDW #OSINT #Intelligence #ThreatIntelligence

### 1. 현재 주요 사이버보안 트렌드
최근 사이버 위협은 AI를 활용한 공격 자동화와 인프라 취약점 악용이 결합된 형태로 진화하고 있습니다. 특히 AI 에이전트를 이용한 자율적인 취약점 탐색 및 공격 시도가 관측되고 있으며, 클라우드 환경의 공유 자원(Cloudflare Workers)을 대상으로 한 Spectre 공격과 같은 고도화된 기술이 실전에서 확인되고 있습니다([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/cloudflare-workers-spectre-attack-leaks.html)). 또한, 공급망 공격과 더불어 랜섬웨어 조직이 복구 업체를 사칭하여 이중으로 피해자를 갈취하는 등 사회공학적 기법이 더욱 정교해지고 있습니다([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/rogue-ransomware-affiliate-ransom-busters-poses-as-recovery-firm/)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
- **PurpleDelta**: 북한 연계 IT 노동자 그룹으로, AI 생성 페르소나와 ChatGPT 어시스턴트를 활용해 기업 채용 프로세스에 침투([Recorded Future](https://www.recordedfuture.com/research/purpledelta-fraudulent-employment-operations)).
- **CopyCop**: 러시아 영향력 네트워크로, 아르메니아의 서방 지원 AI 데이터 센터 및 인프라 프로젝트를 표적으로 삼아 지정학적 영향력 행사([Recorded Future](https://www.recordedfuture.com/blog/copycop-targets-ai-investment)).
- **Head Mare**: TrueConf 서버의 취약점을 악용하여 PhantomCore 및 PhantomGraph 백도어를 배포하는 APT 그룹([Securelist](https://securelist.com/tr/head-mare-targets-trueconf-server-with-phantomcore/120988/)).
- **SilkParasite**: 중앙아시아 조직을 대상으로 RAT(Remote Access Trojan)를 유포하는 중국 연계 그룹([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/threat-intelligence/silkparasite-central-asian-orgs-flurry-rats)).

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
- **인티큐브**: 신한투자증권의 IP 컨택센터(IPCC) 시스템 재구축 사업 착수([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208128)).
- **소프트캠프**: 인미래전략연구원과 업무협약을 체결하여 공공·국방 보안 시장 진출([데일리시큐](https://www.dailysecu.com/news/articleView.html?idxno=208126)).
- **피싱 공격**: 견적서 확인 요청을 위장한 PhantomStealer 유포 사례 확인([AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/94999/)).
- **기타**: KDDI 및 일부 ISP를 통한 1,223만 명의 이메일 정보 유출 사고 관련 일본 보안 소식 공유([securityLab_jp](https://twitter.com/securityLab_jp/status/2090182173970317595)).

### 4. 주요 CVE / 취약점
- **CVE-2026-58231**: SAP Commerce Cloud Data Hub Adapter, CVSS 10.0, 패치 권고([InfosecDotWatch](https://twitter.com/InfosecDotWatch/status/2090197425008902248)).
- **CVE-2026-32475**: Elementor Pro WordPress plugin, RCE 가능, 악용 위험([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/elementor-pro-flaw-could-let.html)).
- **CVE-2026-19478**: GitLab, 인증 없이 프로젝트/데이터 수정 가능, 적극 악용 중([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/critical-gitlab-flaw-exploited-shortly-after-disclosure/)).
- **CVE-2026-68820**: Windows, CISA KEV 등재, 적극 악용 중([Qualys Blog](https://blog.qualys.com/category/product-tech)).

### 5. IOC 요약
- **CVE**:
    - CVE-2026-32475 ([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/08/elementor-pro-flaw-could-let.html))
